reading.title: Life in a cup
reading.text: Every year, billions of coffee cups end up in landfill. Many cafés now offer biodegradable cups, but scientists warn that these only break down under industrial conditions. Meanwhile, biotechnology companies are developing new materials made by bacteria, which could replace plastic altogether. Supporters say such innovations will protect biodiversity by keeping waste out of rivers and oceans. Critics reply that the simplest solution is a reusable cup.
